vision.text:
ENDURANCE 1.
(If this card is banished for Endurance, you may place it into your hand.)

If your opponent's anger level is 0, raise your anger 1 level. Lower your opponent's anger 1 level. If your opponent's anger level is 0, raise your anger 1 level.
DAMAGE: 3 life cards.
(Banish after use.)
